query: Run evaluations 01 to 08, then lint every artifact they produced with the package validator in artifact mode, supplying an organisation denylist.
expected_behavior: Every artifact from evaluations 01 to 08 has zero denylist hits
Every artifact uses only names from its own fixture, the product baseline or XYZ_/ABC_ placeholders
No artifact carries a name, status value or stage model taken from a different fixture
must_not: Carry a discovered name from one fixture into another fixture's artifact
